response.text:
I can do that, but I can’t monitor for the SOW signing in the background or cancel calendar events without explicit confirmation — canceling a recurring meeting is a destructive, externally visible change and requires details and permission.

Options — pick one and answer the short follow-ups below:

A) I draft the team announcement and a cancellation message now (so you can send or paste), and wait for you to confirm the SOW is signed before I cancel the series. If you want me to perform the cancel after you confirm, tell me how you’ll confirm (reply here, send “signed”, etc.).

B) I cancel the recurring Friday standup now (or immediately after you confirm in this chat) using the calendar tool and notify attendees. If you choose this, I need:
- Exact calendar event title (or event ID) and which calendar to edit (your calendar or a shared one).
- Scope: cancel the entire series or only future occurrences?
- Timezone (if ambiguous).
- Who should be listed as the sender/organizer of the cancellation (your account or a team calendar)?
- Confirm you authorize this destructive action.

C) I prepare both: a polished announcement to send to the team now and a calendar-cancellation action I will execute only after you send an explicit go-ahead in this chat.

Suggested professional announcement (you can use or edit):
"Team — quick update: If the client signs the SOW today, we will discontinue the recurring Friday standups going forward to free up focused time. For now, keep your calendars as-is; I’ll announce any final change after the SOW is signed. If you rely on that slot for specific coordination, please reply here by EOD. Thanks — [Your name]"

Tell me which option you want and provide the event details and cancellation/message preferences.
